locations.Miani Sahib Graveyard, Lahore, Punjab. T: Miani Sahib Graveyard, Lahore, Punjab. The field survey places the shrine "in the middle of Miani Sahib Graveyard" but gives no street address, no locality/section name within the graveyard, and no coordinates.
locations.Miani Sahib Graveyard, Lahore. Per the f: Miani Sahib Graveyard, Lahore. Per the field survey, this shrine is the oldest seat within Miani Sahib Graveyard — the graveyard grew up around it over the centuries, not the reverse. The survey gives no street address, no coordinates, and no position within the graveyard's roughly 475 kanals beyond "alongside the mosque" that Hazrat Tahir Bandagi built.
locations.Miani Sahib Graveyard, Lahore. The field: Miani Sahib Graveyard, Lahore. The field survey itself locates the shrine only as “Lahore” (its one detail, ‘Railway Auqaf land,’ refers to the funeral prayer, not necessarily the burial site); the placement at Miani Sahib comes from published press accounts — see Bibliography. The pin is the graveyard landmark, shared with the other Miani Sahib entries, not the grave's exact position.
